result.summary: The page looks mostly polished, but the promotional banner has readability problems due to low-contrast text, and one restaurant name appears truncated.

issues.description: The promotional banner text ('3 free deliveries for you' and the code/min-order details) is light/white on a very pale mint background, making it hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Increase text contrast by using a darker text color or a richer/darker banner background so the copy is clearly legible.

issues.description: The third restaurant name in the 'Fastest near you' section reads 'Trattoria Piccol' and appears cut off without an ellipsis, suggesting the card width truncates the full name.
issues.suggestion: Allow the full restaurant name to display, use a text-wrapping layout, or add a trailing ellipsis to indicate truncation.
